title: Presentability of coherent space-valued presheaves
statement:
Fix nested universes as in [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and let $D$ be a small ordinary category. Let $\mathcal S$ be the infinity category of small spaces, modeled by Kan complexes with their full homotopy coherent mapping spaces, and let $N(D)$ be the ordinary nerve. The infinity category of space-valued presheaves
$$\mathcal P(N(D))=\operatorname{Fun}(N(D)^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$$
is presentable: it has all small colimits and, for some regular cardinal $\kappa$ in the smaller universe, is generated under $\kappa$-filtered colimits by a small set of objects whose mapping-space functors preserve those colimits. This is a statement about coherent functors into spaces, including their natural transformations and higher homotopies.
